captions: I crossed above Trashoprah before sunrise. The snow held my weight; by the spring it had begun to soften. I could tell by the edge of a track I made on my way in.
Iva's marker had risen. I wrote the time and the ice condition because neither of us had expected warmth so soon.
I do not know what warmed it. Tell Saima what we saw together, and tell her what we still cannot say.
greeting.repeatText: The track and the marker belong to the same morning. Please keep the morning with them.

captions: I heard the relay answer after the test. My brother would be pleased you left the weather on the page.
